confidence_notes: Local meal pricing is available mostly for pre-arranged homestay or lodge dinners; coffee and beer use Vietnam-wide 2026 benchmarks adjusted modestly for a rural tourist destination, while cocktail and wine prices are rough beer-based estimates. Lodging is a broad model estimate because inventory and formal star ratings are limited.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close city proxy; used rural northern Vietnam and its tourist-lodge meal pattern, with Vietnam-wide current price benchmarks for common drinks.
